season.evidence: Stored Jun-Oct matches the logged histogram (Jul 29, Aug 26, Sep 28, Oct 38; May 17 and Nov 13 are snow-shoulder trips).

track.why: 9 Aug 2025 summit, round trip from our Round Mountain trailhead pin (14 m), reaches the lookout within 72 m; the only trail route up this side.

otherTracksConsidered.why: 1 Nov 2026, past the stored Oct end; likely snow-covered.
Also a good Aug round trip; not chosen (same line, sparser).

facts.text: Mosquitoes can be thick along much of the trail in early July; by mid-August they are far fewer.
Plan for about 10 to 11 miles round trip and roughly 3,000 feet of gain, more than a one-way reading of the figures suggests.

notes: Our summit pin is 73 m from the surveyed point and tracks top out 28-86 m from ours: within tolerance, no move. All five tracks agree on one route.
